context: Havoc (team TFL/sack/FF/INT/PD rate) and pressure rate (nflverse participation was_pressure, 2016+), sacks, QB hits, clean-vs-pressured EPA, blitz rate (FTN) were already tested on 2026-10-02 (output/research/advanced_metrics.md, matchups_refs.md): havoc improved log loss ~0.0006 in both periods (below the 0.001 bar), pressure/matchup sets made validation worse, market residual tests were at chance. This study tests what has NOT been tested.

A_qb_composite.source: Baldwin's EPA+CPOE composite (nflverse/rbsdm.com); nfeloapp: EPA best balances predictiveness and stability, CPOE more stable but less predictive of single games

features.m_cpoe: team pass offense CPOE minus pass CPOE allowed by its defense, decayed (half-life 8 games) over strictly earlier games, shrunk toward 0 with k=150 attempts; home net minus away net
features.qb_cpoe_diff: starting QB (schedule home_qb_id/away_qb_id) CPOE over his strictly earlier attempts, decayed (half-life 20 games), shrunk with k=200 attempts; home minus away

A_qb_composite.model_test: experiment.py protocol (ridge margin model, train on earlier seasons): add both features; adopt only if log loss improves by >= 0.001 on BOTH validation 2015-19 and holdout 2020-25
A_qb_composite.market_test: OLS of closing-line residual (home margin - spread_line) on z(feature), HC0 SE; dev 2012-19, holdout 2020-25; pass = holdout one-sided p < 0.05/k with the dev sign

B_ftn_quality.source: FTN charting via nflverse (2022+): interception-worthy throws (decision quality; INTs themselves are mostly luck), catchable-ball rate (accuracy), drop rate (receiver luck), QB-fault sacks

features.m_iw: INT-worthy throws per dropback: defense forced minus offense allowed (good-oriented), net home minus away
features.m_catch: catchable-ball rate of aimed passes: offense minus allowed by defense, net
features.m_drop: drop rate on catchable balls: offense minus defense-induced, net (luck hypothesis: expected sign NEGATIVE on the residual)
features.m_qbfault: QB-fault sacks per dropback: defense minus offense, net

B_ftn_quality.market_test: closing-line residual on z(feature); dev 2023, holdout 2024-25 (too few seasons for a model test); pass = holdout one-sided p < 0.05/k with the dev sign (m_drop: pre-specified negative)

C_bye_overpricing.source: arXiv 2408.10867 (Bye-Bye, Bye Advantage, 2024): since the 2011 CBA the bye is worth ~+0.3 pts (CI includes 0) while point spreads price ~+1.0
C_bye_overpricing.rule: fade a team coming off a bye (13+ days rest, regular season, opponent not also off a bye): bet the opponent ATS at the nflverse closing spread_line
C_bye_overpricing.metric: ATS cover rate of the faded side vs 52.38% (one-sided binomial) and ROI at -110; also margin residual (points) for teams off a bye
C_bye_overpricing.pass: holdout cover rate > 52.38% with one-sided p < 0.05 AND dev cover rate > 50%

multiple_comparisons: k = number of market-test features evaluated on a holdout within each candidate family
no_tuning: no thresholds, half-lives or shrinkage values are changed after seeing results; failures are reported as failures
